# Niacin

**Authors:** Soraya Djadjo, Tushar Bajaj

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The uses of niacin are yet to be fully comprehended and embraced. This activity helps improve knowledge of the benefits niacin offers, both for treatment and in reducing the incidence of certain diseases. This activity reviews the pharmacokinetics, administration, indications, contraindications, adverse effects, monitoring, toxicity, and, most importantly, how to enhance interprofessional team outcomes by effectively monitoring the use of this medication.
